text:
1937 年 5 月 6 日。
May sixth, 1937.

兴登堡号抵达莱克赫斯特，晚了几个小时。
The Hindenburg reaches Lakehurst, hours late.

航空站的答复：推迟着陆。飞艇等着。
The station's answer: delay landing. The ship waits.

下午 6 点 21 分，着陆绳放下，
At six twenty-one, the ropes go down,

离系泊塔至少 700 英尺。
at least seven hundred feet from the mast.

起火前几秒，地面上有人看见
Seconds before the fire, a man on the ground

外蒙皮在抖动，就在 5 号气囊附近。
sees the cover flutter, near cell five.

【原声】“一声轰响，大尾翼附近蹿起一团火……”
[1937 newsreel] “a roar and a burst of flame near the big tail fins”

五路来源，指向同一处：4、5 号气囊上方。
Five sources, one place: above gas cells four and five.

从第一道火光到触地：32 秒。
From first flame to impact: thirty-two seconds.

调查认定原因：泄漏的氢气被点燃。
The inquiry names the cause: leaking hydrogen, ignited.

火花本身，至今仍是推论。
The spark itself remains a theory.

【原声】“……夺去了 99 名乘客和机组中近半数的生命。”
[1937 newsreel] “taking the lives of almost half its 99 passengers and crew”
